lines.en: I head over to the cafe to do the same thing I always do in gulping down whatever is placed in front of me. Just now I'm subconsciously hoping it's laced with cyanide.
lines.zh: 我照例跑到咖啡厅，做我一直做的那件事——把端到我面前的任何东西一口灌下去。只是现在，我下意识地希望那里面掺了氰化物。

lines.en: It won't be, of course. Rin still likes me for reasons beyond my comprehension.
lines.zh: 当然不会掺的。出于我无法理解的理由，Rin 依然喜欢我。

lines.en: But if I had to take a guess as to why, it's probably because I'm the only other flesh golem in all of Kumon-mi who likes girls as much as she does.
lines.zh: 但非让我猜的话，大概是因为在整个 Kumon-mi，我是唯一另一个跟她一样喜欢女孩子的肉身傀儡。

lines.en: And if it weren't for these cancerous feelings that make me want to prevent her from becoming as jaded and lost as I am, I'd probably serve as her guide in that area of impractical love.
lines.zh: 如果不是因为这些癌变般的感情——让我想要阻止她变得跟我一样愤世嫉俗、一样迷失——我大概早就成了她在那片不切实际的爱情领域的引路人。

lines.en: I’m glad that she's single again. And I'm glad that she's been learning to gradually move on as of late.
lines.zh: 我很高兴她又恢复单身了。也很高兴她最近在学着慢慢往前走。

lines.en: But I can’t help but wish she'd be smart enough to leave me out of it.
lines.zh: 可我还是忍不住希望她能聪明点，把我从这中间摘出去。

lines.en: A flood of customers all decide to caffeinate at the same time and I seize the opportunity to leave before I get wrapped up in any of it.
lines.zh: 一大群顾客同时决定来补充咖啡因，我趁机溜走，免得被卷进这摊事里。

lines.en: Rin notices me leaving and stops what she’s doing to say goodbye.
lines.zh: Rin 注意到我要走，停下手里的活儿跟我道别。

lines.en: I pretend I don't hear her and walk back out of the cafe and into the street without checking for cars.
lines.zh: 我假装没听见，走出咖啡厅、走到街上，连车都没看一眼。
